audit.evidence: TiKV is an open-source, distributed, and transactional key-value database. Unlike other traditional NoSQL systems, TiKV not only provides classical key-value APIs, but also transactional APIs with ACID compliance. Built in Rust and powered by Raft, TiKV was originally created to complement TiDB, a distributed HTAP database compatible with the MySQL protocol. ／ With the implementation of the Raft consensus algorithm in Rust and consensus state stored in RocksDB, TiKV guarantees data consistency. Placement Driver (PD), which is introduced to implement auto-sharding, enables automatic data migration. The transaction model is similar to Google's Percolator with some performance improvements. TiKV also provides snapshot isolation (SI), snapshot isolation with lock (SQL: `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`), and externally consistent reads and writes in distributed transactions. ／ TiKV was originally a component of TiDB. To run TiKV you must build and run it with PD, which is used to manage a TiKV cluster. You can use TiKV together with TiDB or separately on its own.

identity.one_liner: GaussDB OBS 备份归档打包与 PITR 恢复工具
identity.review: 该工具读取华为云 OBS 上 GaussDB DBS 产生的全量/差异/快照/xlog 备份，按周度或日度打包写入 archive_dir，并生成 PITR 恢复计划，支持清理已归档的 OBS 原始数据（需人工确认）。面向管理 GaussDB 备份的运维人员，使用 SQLite 记录 8 表状态，仅依赖 Python 3.11+ 标准库，对接真实 OBS 时才需安装华为 OBS SDK。
highlights: 自动发现 OBS 中的全量/差异/快照/xlog 备份，按周度或日度打包，按 xlog 时间窗过滤并跳过元数据
提供 PITR 恢复计划生成与执行，支持压缩/非压缩归档与预览（dry-run）模式
删除 OBS 数据的 Reaper 子命令包含 5 道安全门禁，必须人工触发或显式 --yes
use_cases: 将 OBS 上长期累积的 GaussDB DBS 备份打包转储到归档目录以管理对象存储占用
在保留归档的前提下按目标时间点恢复集群数据
内网/离线环境（无 pip 依赖）部署备份归档流程
